# ractermx_domain_tag_assignment (Resource)

Assigns a tag to a RacterMX domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Assign a tag to a domain.
resource "ractermx_domain_tag_assignment" "example" {
  domain_id = ractermx_domain.example.id
  tag_id    = ractermx_domain_tag.production.id
}

resource "ractermx_domain" "example" {
  name = "example.com"
}

resource "ractermx_domain_tag" "production" {
  name  = "production"
  color = "#22c55e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the domain. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `tag_id` (Number) The numeric ID of the tag. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The composite ID of the tag assignment ({domain_id}/{tag_id}).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a tag assignment using the composite key format: {domain_id}/{tag_id}
terraform import ractermx_domain_tag_assignment.example 123/42
```
